en.bdb: If you are wise, be simple;
en.ms: If one be simple, even when wise,

pu.ss: (ਜੋ ਮਨੁੱਖ) ਅਕਲ ਹੁੰਦਿਆਂ ਭੀ ਅੰਞਾਣਾ ਬਣੇ ,

en.bdb: if you are powerful, be weak;
en.ms: be powerless, even when blessed with power,

en.bdb: and when there is nothing to share, then share with others.
en.ms: and shares with others, even when there is almost naught to share;

pu.ss: ਜਦੋਂ ਕੁਝ ਭੀ ਦੇਣ-ਜੋਗਾ ਨਾਹ ਹੋਵੇ, ਤਦੋਂ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪ (ਭਾਵ, ਆਪਣਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ) ਵੰਡ ਦੇਵੇ,

en.bdb: How rare is one who is known as such a devotee. ||128||
en.ms: only some such a rare one is called a saint.

pu.ss: ਕਿਸੇ ਅਜੇਹੇ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੂੰ (ਹੀ) ਭਗਤ ਆਖਣਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ ।੧੨੮।
